text:
Kyler Sato: Hey team — day zero! I’m Kyler (he/him), joining as an Infra SWE on Platform. PST (UTC-8). Quick Q: I haven’t received the laptop MDM invite yet. Also fun fact: I ran a tiny kombucha brewery back in 2020 🍶. Happy to jump on any infra tasks and pair this week.

Maya Li: Welcome Kyler!! :tada: So glad you’re here. @it please check MDM invites. When you get the laptop, go to `https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll` and use your work email. Also add yourself to #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.

mdm-bot: New MDM ticket created: TICKET-4521 — assigned to @it-ops. Kyler, expected invite delivery within ~2 hours.

Juno Park: Hi Kyler — excited to have you aboard. If you want, I can do a 30m walkthrough of our infra repos and deployment flow. I’m free 10–12 PST tomorrow, or later that afternoon.

Tariq Ahmed: Quick access checklist for you: - GitHub: I’ll add you to the org and infra teams. - Jira: invite sent to your work email. - VPN: run `openconnect vpn.redwood.com` and sign in with SSO. I’ll also add you to the infra-oncall group once you’re green.

Kyler Sato: Thanks all — I just checked and the MDM invite landed, enrolled successfully. One follow-up: who’s best to ask about Dedicated GPU quota requests and the request form?

Maya Li: @tleads handles Dedicated capacity requests — I’ll intro you. @Tariq, can you drop the quota process link in this thread?

Tariq Ahmed: Done — DM sent with the quota request template and SLA expectations. Also added a short checklist: model name, expected QPS, preferred region, and fallbacks. Welcome again :rocket:
